description: Read one page of the company's hash-chained audit trail, oldest first. Requires an API key with the `audit:read` scope, held by an owner (an ordinary read key gets insufficient_scope). Filters: eventType (one or several, e.g. ["HIL_APPROVED","CREW_HALTED"]), actor (a uid), from / to (ISO 8601 or epoch ms). limit 1–500 (default 100). Pass the previous page's nextCursor as cursor to continue. Each entry carries sequence, hash, prevHash and sealVersion; a page read without eventType/actor is a contiguous run of the chain (chainContiguous: true) that can be verified.

actor.description: Only entries whose actor is this uid (or system actor).

cursor.description: The nextCursor of the previous page.

eventType.description: One event type or a list of up to 30 (e.g. "MEMBERSHIP_CHANGED").

from.description: Inclusive lower bound: ISO 8601 with a time zone, or epoch milliseconds.

to.description: Inclusive upper bound: ISO 8601 with a time zone, or epoch milliseconds.

name: anyforge_list_audit_events
title: List audit events
